wiki.title: Cory Tomczyk
wiki.extract: Cory Lee Tomczyk (born October 26, 1962) is an American businessman and Republican politician from Marathon County, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin Senate, representing Wisconsin's 29th Senate district since January 2023. He previously served 13 years on the Mosinee School Board, and was president of the school board from 2010 to 2015.
